Chapter 304 - 304 Humiliation; What Are You Fighting About?!

Chapter 304 - 304 Humiliation; What Are You Fighting About?!

304 Humiliation; What Are You Fighting About?!

The reason why Liu Sheng took the initiative to use his own yacht to hold this party at sea was to make himself look good in front of the rich second-generation heirs.

However, look at what happened now.

Now… he was actually looked down upon in public.

Humiliation!

A blatant humiliation!

Even though Liu Sheng had received the best education since he was young, he could not help but feel angry at this moment.

He put away his initial amiable expression and said coldly, “Kid, what did you say?!”

Lin Fan said calmly, “I said, I look down on you.”

“Very well! Kid, you have guts! In Modu, no one has ever said that to me! Fan Yu Investment? I’ll remember it! I’ll definitely make you regret it!” Liu Sheng said sternly.

He had already decided that once he returned to shore, he would look for Lin Fan and teach him a lesson.

At this moment, dull footsteps sounded from the cabin.

“What’s going on outside?”

Before the person arrived, their unhappy voice was heard.

Then, a tall figure walked onto the deck.

When Liu Sheng and the others saw him, they respectfully said, “Hello, Young Master Huang.”

“Young Master Huang.”

The moment Lin Fan caught sight of this person, a strange look appeared on his face.

This so-called Young Master Huang was Huang Tian, whom he had met at Hu Tian’s grandfather’s banquet not long ago.

Huang Tian only nodded slowly in response to everyone’s greetings.

“Young Master Huang, I’m sorry for disturbing you. We just met a brat who doesn’t know his place…”

Huang Tian looked in the direction that Liu Sheng was pointing.

In the next moment…

Huang Tian’s pupils constricted.

Lin Fan!

He was an existence that Huang Tian would never forget!

The moment Huang Tian saw Lin Fan, he seemed to recall the scene of his father bringing him to apologize to Lin Fan.

Huang Tian’s butt and nose started to hurt when he thought about what happened that day.

In fact, Huang Tian had come to Modu for a reason.

A large part of the reason was to come out to relax so that he could forget the miserable memories of that day.

In the end… he actually met Lin Fan again!

Liu Sheng continued, “Young Master Huang, don’t worry. When we return to Modu, I’ll teach this dog a lesson.”

Dog?

He scolded Lin Fan, whom even his father had to treat respectfully, and called him a dog?

He… How dare he?

He was standing together with Liu Sheng. What if Lin Fan thought that they were good friends?

In fact, Lin Fan might even think that… these words were instigated by him… What should he do then?

Huang Tian’s forehead immediately broke out in a layer of sweat.

If he was misunderstood, it would be a disaster—a terrible disaster!

“Shut up!”

Huang Tian shouted and slapped Liu Sheng’s face.

A crisp sound echoed on the deck.

Everyone on the yacht was stunned.

An obvious palm print quickly appeared on Liu Sheng’s face, and his cheek gradually became red and swollen.

However, Huang Tian seemed to think that it was not enough.

Hence, he kicked Liu Sheng to the ground and started punching and kicking him.

A moment later…

Huang Tian bowed and said respectfully, “Mr. Lin, I have nothing to do with this guy… He actually dared to insult you…I’m sorry to have disturbed you…”

Silence.

The entire scene was silent.

The rich second-generation heirs on the yacht all revealed obvious looks of surprise on their faces.

They knew each other very well.

Who was Huang Tian?

Even in the entire Hua Nation, he was still a first-class young master!

This was because the Huang family not only had great power in the political world but also in the business world.

However…

Huang Tian actually beat up Liu Sheng for Mr. Lin.

Then, he even took the initiative to bow and apologize to Mr. Lin?

Who was this Mr. Lin?

What kind of strength did he possess?

Lin Fan glanced at Huang Tian and said calmly, “Huang Tian, you have to be more careful when making friends in the future.”

His tone was like that of a high and mighty elder.

Huang Tian did not feel awkward at all.

On the contrary, he was very happy and quickly said, “Yes, yes… In the future, I’ll definitely be more careful.”

…

A loud whistle sounded not far away.

A business yacht slowly sailed over from afar.

The bald man standing on the deck laughed heartily. “It really is my family’s yacht!”

This bald man was Liu Sheng’s father, Liu Jianqiang.

The surrounding middle-aged men in suits and leather shoes could not help but look over.

The chairman of Tiantian Bank, Huang Jiayi, was also among them.

Liu Jianqiang said, “Chairman Huang, when we have time, let’s take that yacht and go fishing at sea together. What do you think?”

Huang Jiayi nodded.

Seeing this…

Liu Jianqiang was secretly delighted.

Then, Liu Jianqiang pointed at Liu Sheng on the yacht in the distance and said, “Look, my son is up there!”

Obviously, Liu Jianqiang was giving his son a chance to show his face.

One had to know…

The people standing beside him all had extraordinary backgrounds!

As long as his son left a small impression in their hearts, it might bring endless benefits in the future.

At this moment, Liu Jianqiang saw that his son had been slapped.

Then, he was punched and kicked.

The smile on Liu Jianqiang’s face instantly disappeared. He shouted, “Why did you hit my son?!”

This shout attracted the attention of Huang Tian, Lin Fan, and the others on the two yachts.

When Lin Fan turned around, Huang Jiayi saw him too.

His heart skipped a beat, and he said respectfully, “Hello, Mr. Lin!”

This made Liu Jianqiang, who was originally arrogant, slightly stunned. It made the others on the yacht reveal a touch of surprise.

One had to know…

Huang Jiayi was the chairman of the largest private bank in China, Tiantian Bank.

Others always treated him respectfully and kept trying to please him.

When had they ever seen Huang Jiayi treat others with such respect?

Moreover, it was to a young man who looked to be in his 20s.

“Oh, it’s you, Old Huang…” Lin Fan said.

Old Huang?

Calling the chairman of Tiantian Bank… Old Huang?

The middle-aged men on the business yacht were even more shocked.

At the same time, they started to guess Lin Fan’s identity.

At this moment, Liu Sheng got up from the ground.

Everyone had a temper.

He was beaten up and saw his father not far away.

He no longer cared about Huang Tian’s and Lin Fan’s identities.

He pointed at the two of them and shouted, “Bastards, how dare you humiliate and hit me?!”
